integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1 ] frame presents vertical control, background maintains the pure space to enter line art frame, tendering. The centre of the frame is a clear black line at character contour, and the line is fluid and simple. As time goes on, line art begins to light up, the black line gradually fills with real skin sense and clothing colours, showing a smooth transition from line att to real character. Character's posture began with a slight stretching of static standing positions, and there appeared to be little dust floating around the air, creating a fantastic and delicate atmosphere. Film-class graphics, contours are clear: 1.5, light is fine, and the view is medium. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000 (3-6 seconds), the camera is fixed and the fully physical real character starts dancing in the frame. Caracter image, hairstyle, outfit, and line art are consistent and unchanged. [ACTION] caractor moves gently, with graceful swings of arms, body moves with rhythm, clothes floats, dance moves around the air and lighting. Dancing moves with a rhythm of energy and self-confidence. [/ACtion] The whole frame is beautiful, the visual focus is entirely on character's dance performance, and the colours are moving from line white and black to soft natural color color.

overall_soundscape: The initial phase was accompanied by a mild magic scintillation of sound effects and air flow, followed by a clear, rhythmic movement of footsteps and clothing frictions, along with the breath of character dance, and the overall atmosphere of lightness and rhythm.

non_diegetic_music: It's a modern, simple, electronic, background music, light and fast, with a light synthetic sound, a simple repetition of melody, synchronized with dance moves, creating a fashionable and dynamic atmosphere.

Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. If the prompt text and a reference image disagree, the reference image WINS. The output character's face MUST look like the person in <Picture 1>@图1 — same eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, eyebrow shape, hairline, hair color, hair texture, and facial proportions. The output outfit MUST look like the clothing in the outfit reference picture — same garment type, same sleeves, same hem length, same color, same pattern, same texture, same buttons/zippers/pockets, same collar, same waistline, same accessories. If the reference image shows a specific outfit, the video shows THAT exact outfit — not a different color, not a different pattern, not a different cut. For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1>@图1 (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced. Preserve the exact facial identity, hairstyle, and clothing of the figure from the reference image.

integrated_multimodal_description:  [镜头1]【0-3秒】画面呈现竖构图，背景保持输入线稿画面的纯净空间，光线柔和均匀。画面中央是一个清晰的黑色线稿人物轮廓，线条流畅简洁。随着时间推移，线稿表面开始泛起微光，黑色线条逐渐填充上真实的皮肤质感与衣物色彩，呈现出从线稿到真实人物的平滑过渡。人物姿态由静止的站立姿势开始微微舒展，周围空气中似乎有细微的光尘漂浮，营造出梦幻而精致的氛围。电影级画质，轮廓清晰:1.5，光影细腻，景深适中。[镜头2] 在00:03.000【3-6秒】，镜头保持固定机位，完全实体化的真实人物开始在画面中跳舞。人物形象、发型、服装与线稿所对应的人物保持一致，不被改变。【ACTION】人物动作轻盈流畅，双臂优雅地挥动，身体随着节奏摆动，衣摆随之飘动，舞蹈动作带动周围空气与光线流动。舞蹈动作充满韵律感，展现出活力与自信。【/ACTION】整体画面唯美，视觉焦点完全集中在人物的舞蹈表现上，色彩从线稿的黑白灰过渡到柔和的自然彩色色调。

overall_soundscape: 起始阶段伴随轻微的魔法般的闪烁音效和空气流动声，随后过渡到清晰、有节奏感的脚步声和衣物摩擦声，伴随着人物舞蹈时的呼吸声，整体氛围轻快而富有韵律。

non_diegetic_music: 一段现代简约的电子背景音乐，节奏轻快明快，带有轻微的合成器音色，旋律简单重复，与舞蹈动作同步，营造出时尚且充满活力的氛围。

integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-3s] The frame opens in portrait composition. The background is a clean white space with soft, even lighting. At center frame is a clear black line-art human figure with smooth, minimal strokes. Over time, a faint glow rises from the line drawing; black lines gradually fill with realistic skin texture and clothing color, presenting a smooth transition from sketch to real person. Clothing wrinkles and fabric movement are realistic.【/ACTION】 Lighting stays consistent with the line art's original composition, softly illuminating the figure and its clothing folds. The overall color palette transitions from line-art monochrome to natural tones.

overall_soundscape: Initial faint magical shimmer and air flow, transitioning to clear rhythmic footsteps on solid ground, subtle clothing rustle, and calm breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A light ambient electronic track with slow tempo, soft synth pads, and minimal percussion, creating a calm and hopeful atmosphere.

overall_soundscape: 客厅安静的空气感，画框内传来轻微的嗡鸣与发光声，小人物走出画框、脚步踩上真实地面的轻响，画中光芒缓缓收敛的细碎声，整体奇幻而温暖。

templates.name: Seed Sprouting to Full Bloom
templates.description: The complete growth of a seed: breaking the soil, sprouting, shooting up, budding and blooming into a flower
templates.description_en: The complete growth of a seed: breaking the soil, sprouting, shooting up, budding and blooming into a flower
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse, fixed camera at a low angle close to dark, moist soil. A single brown seed rests on the soil surface at frame center. The seed coat cracks, a pale root tip pushes downward into the soil, and a tender pale-green shoot emerges upward, splitting open as two rounded cotyledon leaves unfold. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a slightly wider angle. The stem lengthens and thickens rapidly, true leaves grow out and spread toward the light, and the plant rises through the center of the frame. Tiny water droplets glisten on the leaves. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of the stem tip. A green bud swells, petals gradually unfurl from the tip outward, and the flower opens fully, revealing bright layered petals and a yellow center. The plant sways gently as if in a light breeze, and the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the fully opened bloom.

overall_soundscape: Soft soil shifting, the delicate rustle of leaves unfurling, a faint breeze, and a single low drone of ambient nature.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle piano arpeggio at a slow tempo with soft sustained strings that gradually swell as the flower opens, then fade to a quiet resolution.

templates.description: Time-lapse of a vine winding and climbing up a stone wall or a trellis
templates.description_en: Time-lapse of a vine winding and climbing up a stone wall or a trellis
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed medium-wide shot of a garden trellis in soft daylight. A thin green vine at the base begins to extend upward, its tip curling and searching in small circles. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a closer framing following the vine tip. The vine grows steadily upward, tendrils wrapping around the trellis posts and stone edges, small heart-shaped leaves sprouting along the stem in rapid succession, each leaf unfolding as it emerges. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot of the upper trellis. The vine reaches the top and spreads sideways, covering the trellis with dense green foliage, a few small flowers budding and opening among the leaves. Soft daylight rakes across the leaves, and the camera tilts up slowly as the vine completes its climb.

overall_soundscape: Gentle wind through leaves, the soft rasp of tendrils brushing stone, distant birdsong, and a quiet natural ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A light acoustic guitar pattern at a moderate tempo with soft woodwind accompaniment, warm and organic, ending on a calm held note.

templates.description_en: Macro time-lapse of a cluster of mushrooms pushing through the forest floor and opening their caps
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse, a low fixed camera close to a forest floor. The soil surface shows a faint crack in the center; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a tighter macro angle. Small white mushroom caps push up through the soil and leaf litter, their stems elongating as the caps rise, lifting fallen leaves aside. The caps swell and round out, gills visible beneath the edges. [Shot 3] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a wider low angle. A cluster of mushrooms stands fully grown at different heights, their caps unfurling like small umbrellas, morning dew beading on the caps. A single ray of light falls on the tallest mushroom, and the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude.

overall_soundscape: The soft crackle of soil and leaves parting, a faint damp forest ambience, dripping water, and a low rustle of wind in the canopy.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse, gentle piano motif at a slow tempo with soft ambient pads, quiet and earthy, fading to near silence at the end.

templates.name: Tree Growing Through the Seasons
templates.description: A sapling grows into a towering tree and passes through spring, summer, autumn and winter
templates.description_en: A sapling grows into a towering tree and passes through spring, summer, autumn and winter
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of an open meadow under a large sky. A small sapling with a few leaves stands at frame center; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The sapling grows taller and thicker in fast motion, branches spreading outward as the seasons cycle. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium-wide angle. Spring arrives: the tree bursts into fresh green leaves, pink blossom clusters bloom and fall. The camera remains still. Summer follows as the canopy thickens into deep green. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a wider view. Autumn colors wash over the leaves from green to gold to red, and the leaves drift down in spirals; then winter comes, bare branches gather frost and snow, and the ground turns white. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a full wide shot. The mature tree stands in a fresh spring once more, covered in new green leaves, clouds racing across the sky behind it, and the camera slowly pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed to reveal the whole tree against the landscape.

overall_soundscape: Wind in changing seasons, rustling leaves, drifting snow, birdsong in spring, and a continuous low ambient drone.

non_diegetic_music: A lyrical string-and-piano theme at a slow tempo that changes texture with each season, ending on a warm, resolved chord.

templates.name: Caterpillar to Butterfly
templates.description: Complete metamorphosis: a caterpillar spins a cocoon, pupates, emerges and spreads its wings as a butterfly
templates.description_en: Complete metamorphosis: a caterpillar spins a cocoon, pupates, emerges and spreads its wings as a butterfly
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse, a fixed close-up of a green leaf on a sunlit branch. A striped caterpillar crawls across the leaf, then hangs upside down and spins a silken thread around itself, gradually forming a smooth chrysalis. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a tighter macro angle on the chrysalis. The chrysalis darkens and begins to crack along its back; the crack widens slowly as a damp, crumpled head and antennae push out. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a side close-up. A butterfly emerges, clinging to the empty shell, its soft wet wings slowly unfurling and straightening, wing patterns and colors deepening as they dry. [Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a wider angle. The butterfly spreads its fully dried wings wide, then lifts off the branch and flutters away into warm backlit forest air, and the camera tracks it briefly before holding on the empty chrysalis.

overall_soundscape: Gentle breeze, the faint rasp of silk and cracking shell, soft wing beats as the butterfly flies away, and warm forest ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A delicate harp and flute melody at a slow tempo, airy and bright, swelling gently as the butterfly takes flight and resolving softly.

templates.name: Tadpole to Frog
templates.description: A tadpole grows legs in a pond, sheds its tail, turns into a frog and hops onto land
templates.description_en: A tadpole grows legs in a pond, sheds its tail, turns into a frog and hops onto land
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed underwater medium shot in a clear shallow pond. A cluster of dark tadpoles with small tails swims among green water plants near the surface; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The tadpoles grow slowly, hind legs budding and lengthening behind their bodies. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a closer underwater angle. The tadpoles develop front legs, their tails slowly shrink and are absorbed into their bodies, and their bodies change from round to a sleeker frog shape. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a low angle at the water surface. Young frogs climb onto a lily pad and a muddy bank at the pond edge, their skin darkening to green-brown with spots, and one frog takes a first short hop. [Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a wider shot of the bank. The frog leaps from the bank onto a stone and then out of frame into tall grass, leaving ripples on the water, and the camera holds on the quiet pond.

overall_soundscape: Underwater bubbling, water ripples and splashes, soft croaks, and a calm pond ambience with distant birds.

non_diegetic_music: A light, playful woodwind and pizzicato strings piece at a moderate tempo, gentle and bouncy, ending with a soft chord.
templates.description_zh: 蝌蚪在水塘中长腿、蜕尾、变态为青蛙并跃上陆地

templates.name: Hatchling to Adult Bird
templates.description: An egg cracks open, the chick feeds and fledges, then spreads its wings and leaves the nest
templates.description_en: An egg cracks open, the chick feeds and fledges, then spreads its wings and leaves the nest
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed close-up of a small nest of twigs and moss holding three pale blue eggs, in a tree at golden morning light. A small crack appears on one egg and slowly widens; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a slightly wider angle. A wet chick breaks the shell open, tumbles out, and huddles in the nest as its siblings hatch, all three gaping for food; a parent bird briefly lands to feed them. The chicks grow quickly, grey down replacing with small feathers. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up. The young birds are fully feathered and flutter their wings on the nest rim, testing balance, wings beating fast. [Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a wide shot of the branch and sky. One by one the young birds leap from the nest and glide clumsily out of frame into the open sky, and the camera holds on the empty nest swaying gently.

overall_soundscape: Soft tapping and cracking of shells, high-pitched cheeping, rapid wing beats, and a bright morning forest ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A cheerful flute and light strings melody at a moderate tempo, bright and hopeful, ending as the birds fly off.
templates.description_zh: 鸟蛋破壳、雏鸟进食、羽毛长全后展翅离巢
templates.generation_mode_zh: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】

templates.name: Puppy Growing Up
templates.description: Growth time-lapse of a puppy from birth to adult dog, from a fixed viewpoint
templates.description_en: Growth time-lapse of a puppy from birth to adult dog, from a fixed viewpoint
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed medium shot of a cozy wooden-floored room corner with a soft blanket. A tiny newborn puppy with closed eyes lies curled on the blanket; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The puppy wriggles and slowly opens its eyes, ears beginning to lift. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing slightly wider. The puppy grows through fast motion, learning to stand on wobbly legs, taking clumsy first steps, its paws and body enlarging, short fur thickening. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium-wide shot. The now larger puppy runs playfully in a circle on the floor, tail wagging, tongue out, before sitting and looking up at the camera with bright eyes. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of the grown dog's face. It tilts its head, blinks once, and gives a happy open-mouth pant, soft window light on its fur, and the camera pushes in very slightly.

overall_soundscape: Soft whimpers, the patter of paws on wood, gentle panting, a tail thumping, and a warm indoor room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A warm, simple ukulele and light percussion track at a moderate tempo, cheerful and cozy, ending with a gentle strum.
templates.description_zh: 一只幼犬从出生到长大成犬的成长延时，同一视角

templates.name: Baby to Adult One-Shot
templates.description: The same baby grows into a young adult in one continuous shot, with facial features preserved throughout
templates.description_en: The same baby grows into a young adult in one continuous shot, with facial features preserved throughout
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Photorealistic, front-facing portrait, a static medium close-up. A newborn baby lies against a plain, warm, neutral background, eyes gently opening. The camera is static; the frame never moves. The person grows seamlessly and continuously in one take: becoming a chubby toddler with the same face shape, then a school-age child, then a teenager, then a young adult, the same face shape and soft expression preserved at every age, the overall look developing naturally over time. [Shot 2] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The person is now fully grown, gentle smile, the plain neutral background unchanged, soft even light, slow seamless aging transition, front-facing portrait framing throughout. [Shot 3] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a very slight close-up on the face. The person blinks slowly, smiles warmly at the camera, hair brushed by an unseen breeze, then the frame holds on the calm expression as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: A quiet, warm indoor tone with a very faint breeze, soft fabric movement, and gentle breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A tender piano and soft strings piece at a slow tempo, warm and nostalgic, ending on a sustained gentle note.
templates.description_zh: 同一个婴儿在连续镜头中成长为青年，五官特征全程保持

templates.name: Aging Portrait
templates.description: The same frontal portrait ages from youth to old age, wrinkles and white hair gradually appearing
templates.description_en: The same frontal portrait ages from youth to old age, wrinkles and white hair gradually appearing
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Photorealistic, front-facing portrait, a static close-up of a person in their 20s with smooth skin, neutral studio lighting, plain grey background. The camera is static; the frame never moves. The face ages in slow seamless morph: skin texture gradually coarsens, fine lines deepen around the eyes and mouth, hair begins to grey at the temples. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The person is now middle-aged: deeper wrinkles, greying hair, slightly softened jawline, the same eyes and nose structure clearly preserved. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The person is now elderly: silver-white hair, pronounced wrinkles, gentle weathered skin, the same warm eyes and recognizable features still intact. The person blinks slowly and gives a soft, serene smile. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a very slight close-up on the face and holds; the person looks steadily at the camera, breathing softly, and the frame freezes on the face as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: A calm, quiet studio room tone with a faint low hum and soft breathing throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse solo cello line at a slow tempo with soft piano chords, melancholic yet serene, resolving gently at the end.
templates.description_zh: 同一张正面肖像从青春到暮年逐渐老去，皱纹白发浮现
templates.generation_mode_zh: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】

templates.name: Life Journey Timeline
templates.description: One person's life from infancy to old age unfolds across a continuous lateral tracking shot
templates.description_en: One person's life from infancy to old age unfolds across a continuous lateral tracking shot
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic, photorealistic, a continuous lateral tracking shot at a steady pace across a 15-second timeline. The camera glides smoothly from left to right with zero cuts as one person travels through every stage of life while the surrounding world seamlessly evolves in real time. The sequence begins on a newborn cradled in a parent's arms under soft light. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot transitions as the camera keeps moving right: the child grows into a toddler running through an open outdoor space, then a school-age child walking along a quiet street, the surroundings subtly changing with time. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot continues: the person is a young adult walking through an everyday urban area, then a middle-aged figure walking through the same area as the light turns golden, buildings and trees around them aging and changing with time. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot completes: the elderly person walks slowly toward a bench under a tree as dusk falls, sits down, and looks toward the camera with a peaceful smile, and the camera gently slows and holds on their face.

overall_soundscape: Shifting environmental ambience from nursery sounds to birdsong, city traffic, wind, and evening crickets, with steady footsteps throughout.

non_diegetic_music: A lyrical orchestral theme that evolves with each life stage, warm strings and piano, ending in a quiet, resolved cadence.
templates.description_zh: 一个人从婴儿到暮年的一生在连续横移镜头中展开
templates.generation_mode_zh: Text to Video (文生视频)【图3可选场景】

templates.name: Character Metamorphosis
templates.description: The same person transforms from inexperienced to mature, from an old self to a new one
templates.description_en: The same person transforms from inexperienced to mature, from an old self to a new one
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic portrait, a medium shot of a shy, casually dressed young person standing against a plain wall in muted light. The person looks down, then slowly lifts their head toward the camera; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Time-lapse change sweeps over them: their look becomes neatly groomed, casual attire is replaced by formal attire, posture straightens, shoulders pull back, and the expression shifts from hesitant to calm and confident. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer medium shot. The person is now a poised professional in formal wear, standing in soft warm light, a subtle confident smile on their face, eyes steady. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of their face. The person turns slightly, adjusts their cuff, and looks directly into the camera with a composed, self-assured gaze, and the camera holds as the video ends.

overall_soundscape: Quiet indoor room tone, soft fabric rustle as clothes change, a faint heartbeat-like pulse, and steady breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A modern cinematic track that builds from sparse piano to fuller strings and soft percussion as the transformation unfolds, ending on a confident resolved chord.
templates.description_zh: 同一人物从青涩到成熟、从旧我到新我的蜕变

templates.name: Crystal Cluster Growth
templates.description: Time-lapse of crystal clusters in a cavern growing rapidly from tiny buds into huge crystals
templates.description_en: Time-lapse of crystal clusters in a cavern growing rapidly from tiny buds into huge crystals
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic macro time-lapse inside a dark cave, a fixed close-up of a rocky wall pocket. Tiny glassy crystal nubs begin to appear on the rock surface; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a tighter angle. The crystals lengthen and thicken rapidly in fast motion, faceted prisms pushing outward at different angles, catching faint blue cave light and sparkling. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up. A dense cluster of large translucent crystals fills the pocket, their sharp tips glinting, a thin film of water shimmering over their surfaces. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a wider low angle. The full crystal cluster gleams in a shaft of pale light from above, and the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude.

overall_soundscape: A resonant cavern ambience, faint crystalline chimes as the crystals form, and a low echoing drip of water.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist ambient track with shimmering high bell tones and deep sustained pads, mysterious and crystalline, fading quietly.
templates.description_zh: 岩洞中水晶簇从微小晶芽快速生长成巨大晶体的延时

templates.name: City Expansion from Empty Land
templates.description: Aerial time-lapse of an empty lot rapidly growing into a complete modern city
templates.description_en: Aerial time-lapse of an empty lot rapidly growing into a complete modern city
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a high fixed vantage point above an empty flat parcel of land bordered by farmland and a river; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the same aerial framing. Road grids appear first, then foundations and building skeletons rise rapidly, cranes moving in fast motion, streets filling with tiny vehicles. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a slightly lower aerial angle. Towering glass buildings complete, parks and plazas fill in with trees, and the district becomes a dense modern city center. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the shot cuts to a wide aerial view at dusk. The completed city lights turn on building by building, traffic light trails stream along the roads, and the camera slowly pulls out and rises to reveal the whole glowing district against the darkening landscape.

overall_soundscape: Distant construction clatter and cranes, faint traffic rumble, wind over the city, and a low urban ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A modern orchestral build with steady percussion and rising strings, optimistic and expansive, ending in a bright full chord.
templates.description_zh: 一片空地快速生长出完整现代城市的延时航拍

templates.name: Skyscraper Construction
templates.description: Complete construction time-lapse of a skyscraper, from excavation to topping out
templates.description_en: Complete construction time-lapse of a skyscraper, from excavation to topping out
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a high-angle view of a deep excavation pit in a dense downtown district. Yellow tower cranes swing steel beams into place rhythmically against a backdrop of existing glass skyscrapers; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to the same aerial angle. The building skeleton rises rapidly floor by floor, concrete cores and steel frames growing upward, cranes climbing alongside, workers and machinery moving in fast motion. The sunlight cycle shifts from dawn to golden hour to deep blue twilight. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a closer diagonal angle. The tower tops out and glass curtain walls are installed section by section, the facade becoming a reflective skin of windows. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a low upward angle. The completed skyscraper stands against a twilight sky, windows lighting up from lower to upper floors, and the camera executes a slow, stabilized push-in toward the central structure.

overall_soundscape: Distant crane machinery, rhythmic steel clangs, wind around the tower, and a low urban construction ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A modern epic orchestral track with steady percussion and brass, building to a triumphant peak as the tower completes, then resolving.
templates.description_zh: 一座摩天大楼从基坑到封顶的完整施工延时

templates.name: City Day-Night Transition
templates.description: Time-lapse of the same city skyline shifting in light from dawn to night
templates.description_en: Time-lapse of the same city skyline shifting in light from dawn to night
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of a modern city skyline with tall skyscrapers, pre-dawn blue hour. The sky brightens as the sun rises behind the towers; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Bright daylight floods the scene, clouds race across the sky, shadows sweep across the buildings as the sun arcs overhead. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Golden hour sunset washes the towers in warm orange light, then the light fades into deep blue twilight. [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to the same framing at night. Windows light up one by one across the skyline, neon and street lights glow, and light trails from moving traffic streak along the streets below; the camera slowly pushes in with very small amplitude.

overall_soundscape: A low urban hum, distant traffic, wind over the towers, and a gradual shift from birdsong at dawn to city night ambience.

non_diegetic_music: A smooth ambient electronic track with soft pads and gentle pulse, evolving in warmth through the day cycle, ending on a calm night chord.
templates.description_zh: 同一城市天际线从清晨到夜晚的光影变换延时

templates.name: Interior Renovation Timelapse
templates.description: Full time-lapse of a bare-shell apartment being finished and furnished
templates.description_en: Full time-lapse of a bare-shell apartment being finished and furnished
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of an empty concrete room with bare walls, a window at the far end, and daylight entering; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Scaffolding appears, workers move in fast motion, drywall partitions rise, plumbing and electrical conduits are installed, and plaster coats the walls. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. Flooring is laid, walls are painted, cabinetry and light fixtures are mounted, and furniture is moved in piece by piece, the room filling with a warm interior. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a slightly lower angle. The finished room is complete with soft furnishings, warm lamps glowing, and a view of dusk through the window; the camera pushes in slowly with small amplitude toward the lit interior.

overall_soundscape: Rapid construction noises, hammering, sawing, footsteps, and a gradual transition to a quiet, cozy indoor room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A light acoustic track with gentle guitar and soft percussion, upbeat and satisfying, ending on a warm settled note.
templates.description_zh: 一间毛坯房从空壳到精装完成的全过程延时

templates.name: Bridge Construction Completion
templates.description: Majestic construction time-lapse of a sea-crossing bridge, from piers to deck closure
templates.description_en: Majestic construction time-lapse of a sea-crossing bridge, from piers to deck closure
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic aerial time-lapse, a wide view of a sea strait with massive bridge piers rising from the water in a long row; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a closer aerial angle along the piers. Tower cranes and gantries lift massive steel girder segments into place, the deck extending section by section across the water, ships passing beneath. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a low side angle near the gap. The final deck segments are lifted and fitted, the two ends meeting in a precise closure at the center of the span. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a wide aerial view at sunset. The completed bridge spans the strait, cables taut and lights switching on along the deck as dusk falls, and the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full scale.

overall_soundscape: Heavy machinery, metallic clangs, wind over open water, lapping waves, and a low distant hum of the structure.

non_diegetic_music: A grand orchestral piece with brass and strings, steady and monumental, swelling as the bridge completes and resolving majestically.

templates.name: Exploded-View Product Assembly
templates.description: A product assembles from an exploded view, layer by layer, into the finished item
templates.description_en: A product assembles from an exploded view, layer by layer, into the finished item
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] 3D product visualization, a fixed medium shot on a clean white studio background with soft directional shadows. A modern wireless speaker hangs in exploded-view: its outer casing, grille, driver, circuit board, and base plate are separated along their axes, floating in space. The camera is static; the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to the same framing. The inner circuit board moves inward and seats onto the base, then the driver lowers into the chassis, each part gliding along its axis in sequence. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a slightly tighter angle. The grille and outer casing close over the internal parts, the shell snapping shut with a satisfying fit, seams aligning perfectly. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a three-quarter angle. The fully assembled speaker rotates slowly 180 degrees on a turntable, every surface clean and sharp, and the camera pushes in slightly to showcase the finished product.

overall_soundscape: Soft mechanical clicks as parts seat together, a faint whir of the turntable, and a quiet clean studio tone.

non_diegetic_music: A modern minimal electronic track with crisp synth pulses and light percussion, precise and premium, ending on a clean resolved note.

templates.name: 3D Printing Process
templates.description: Time-lapse of a 3D printer building a three-dimensional object layer by layer
templates.description_en: Time-lapse of a 3D printer building a three-dimensional object layer by layer
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic macro, a fixed medium close-up of a 3D printer nozzle above an empty build plate in a softly lit workshop; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a side angle through the printer frame. The nozzle moves back and forth rapidly, laying down fine layers of material that stack upward, the object taking shape layer by layer, thin filament lines visible on the surface. [Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a closer angle on the growing object. A detailed geometric sculpture emerges, its layers smoothing as the print nears completion, the nozzle making a final pass. [Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to a medium shot. The print head lifts away and the completed object stands on the build plate; the plate lowers and the object is revealed fully formed, and the camera arcs slowly around it.

overall_soundscape: The rhythmic whir and click of the printer head, a soft electric hum, and a quiet workshop room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A minimalist electronic track with repeating arpeggios and soft beats, methodical and precise, ending with a clean final chord.

templates.name: Smartwatch Assembly Line
templates.description: Industrial time-lapse of precision smart-watch parts being assembled one by one into a complete unit
templates.description_en: Industrial time-lapse of precision smart-watch parts being assembled one by one into a complete unit
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic industrial visualization, a fixed close-up on a clean assembly surface under bright even light. The internal components of a smartwatch — screen module, battery, main board, sensors, and case — lie arranged and separated; the camera is static, the frame never moves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a tighter macro angle. The main board is placed into the case, the battery seats beside it, flex cables connect, and the sensor array clicks into position, each micro-part guided by robotic precision. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up. The display module presses down onto the case and seals seamlessly, the crown and button insert into the side. [Shot 4] At 00:10.500, the shot cuts to a three-quarter angle. The finished smartwatch lies on the surface, screen briefly lighting up with a glowing watch face before dimming, and the camera pushes in slowly.

overall_soundscape: Delicate mechanical clicks, soft servo whirs, a faint electronic chime as the screen lights up, and a clean lab room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A refined electronic track with soft plucks and gentle percussion, sleek and modern, ending on a subtle ambient note.
templates.description_zh: 智能手表的精密零件逐一组装成整机的工业延时

templates.name: Building Blocks Construction
templates.description: Colored building blocks go from scattered pieces to a completed model
templates.description_en: Colored building blocks go from scattered pieces to a completed model
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic stop-motion-style time-lapse, a fixed wide shot of a clean white table with scattered colorful building blocks; the camera is static, the frame never moves. The completed block house stands on the table in bright natural light, and the camera arcs slowly around it before settling on the front view.

overall_soundscape: Sharp plastic clicks as blocks snap together, a soft thump as layers settle, and a bright playful room tone.

non_diegetic_music: A cheerful plucky melody with light xylophone and percussion, playful and upbeat, ending on a happy resolved note.

templates.name: Highway Light Trails
templates.description: Time-lapse of traffic drawing red and white light trails along a highway at night
templates.description_en: Time-lapse of traffic drawing red and white light trails along a highway at night
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] Cinematic time-lapse, a high elevated fixed angle above a multi-lane highway curving through a city at night; the camera is static, the frame never moves. integrated_multimodal_description:
【STAGE 1 — CORE THEME】gritty hard sci-fi noir | dark fantasy underworld | battle-damage aesthetic | rain-soaked concrete | post-apocalyptic live-action | cinematic realism

[STAGE 2 — CHARACTER & SCENE]<Subject 1> stands in the center of <Picture 3>@Picture 3's environment, clothing showing visible wear: frayed cuffs, scuffed boots, faint bloodstains on the collar. Skin retains minor imperfections — pores, faint scars, five-o'clock shadow. <Subject 2> approaches from the background, silhouette distinct from <Subject 1>: different build, different wardrobe, different facial structure. The environment around them shows lived-in decay: peeling paint, cracked tiles, flickering fluorescent light overhead, water pooling on the floor reflecting the harsh light.

【STAGE 3 — ATMOSPHERE & QUALITY】Simulated IMAX film camera + Panavision C-series lens (35mm focal, f/4 aperture). Low-saturation teal-and-orange color grade, heavy film grain (35mm stock), volumetric fog catching the overhead light. Subsurface scattering on skin, rough specular on wet surfaces. No over-smoothing, no plastic skin — every imperfection preserved. Chiaroscuro lighting: single harsh key light from above, deep shadows swallowing the background, rim light separating both figures from the darkness.

【STAGE 4 — CAMERA RULES】Handheld shot — extremely subtle, breath-like camera float throughout, as if held by a human operator with slightly unsteady hands. Slow dolly-in toward <Subject 1> as the scene progresses, shallow depth of field (f/4) keeping <Subject 1> sharp while <Subject 2> and the background soften into bokeh. No rapid cuts, no shaky-cam excess — the movement is organic and restrained.

【STAGE 5 — STORYBOARD】
[0-2s] Establishing: <Subject 1> stands motionless in the puddle-lit room, chest rising and falling with heavy breathing. Water drips from the ceiling somewhere off-screen, each drop sending a ripple across the floor. <Subject 2>'s silhouette emerges from the dark corridor in the background, footsteps slow and deliberate.
[2-4s] Tension: <Subject 1>'s eyes flick toward <Subject 2>, jaw tightening. A bead of sweat traces down <Subject 1>'s temple, catching the fluorescent light. <Subject 2> stops ten feet away, shoulders squared. Neither speaks. The fluorescent light above buzzes and flickers once, casting both figures into brief silhouette.
[4-6s] Confrontation: <Subject 2> takes one step forward, boot splashing in a puddle. <Subject 1> shifts weight to the back foot, hands rising slowly into a guarded stance. The camera's breath-like float becomes slightly more pronounced, mirroring the rising tension. A distant metal clang echoes through the empty space.
[6-8s] Empty ending: No dialogue. No explosion. No blinding light. Just the two figures frozen in their stances, rain beginning to fall through a broken skylight, each drop catching the harsh overhead light as it falls. The camera holds on the wide shot, neither figure moving, as the sound of dripping water fades into silence.

overall_soundscape: Production audio only. Heavy, measured breathing from <Subject 1> in the foreground. Slow, deliberate footsteps of <Subject 2> on wet concrete. The constant low hum of a flickering fluorescent tube. Distant water dripping from a broken pipe, each drop echoing in the empty space. A single far-off metal clang somewhere in the building's depths. No music, no score — the silence between sounds is as important as the sounds themselves.

non_diegetic_music: None. No score. Production audio only. The emptiness of the sound design IS the score — every breath, every footstep, every drip carries weight in the silence.

Earth rotates slowly below — a storm system visible as a vast swirling white pattern, city lights beginning to twinkle on the night side. <Subject 1> reaches up, touching the visor briefly, as if absorbing the view. <Subject 2> also pauses, both astronauts floating in silence, looking at the planet. The sun dips behind Earth's curve, casting both figures into sudden, beautiful darkness, illuminated only by the blue glow of the atmosphere.

Just the two astronauts floating in the blue glow of Earth's atmosphere, looking down at the planet, the station's metal panels glowing faintly in the reflected light. The camera holds on the wide shot — two tiny figures against the vastness of space and the curve of the Earth — as the sound of breathing inside the helmets and the faint creak of metal fades into the absolute silence of vacuum.

The low, resonant creak of the station's metal structure expanding and contracting in the sunlight. Faint radio static between the two astronauts, occasional soft clicks of communication. No music, no score — the silence of space IS the soundtrack, every breath and every metallic creak carrying weight in the vacuum.

templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:  [Shot 1] [0-12s] Cinematic timelapse. A single tree in a grassy field undergoes all four seasons in rapid succession. [0-3s] Spring: bare branches bud with fresh green leaves, grass turns vibrant green, cherry blossoms bloom around the base, light is soft and fresh. [3-6s] Summer: the tree is in full leaf, deep green canopy, grass is tall and lush, warm golden light, butterflies and dragonflies flit through the frame. [6-9s] Autumn: leaves turn from green to gold, orange, and red, then begin to fall — swirling in the wind, grass browns and dries, light becomes amber and low. [9-12s] Winter: the tree is bare, snow falls and accumulates on branches and ground, the scene is monochrome white and grey, cold blue light. The transitions between seasons are smooth — one morphs into the next with visible changes spreading across the frame. The camera is fixed throughout.

overall_soundscape: Wind sounds that change character with each season — gentle spring breeze, warm summer gust, autumn leaf-rustle wind, and cold winter howl. Bird songs in spring and summer, silence in winter.

non_diegetic_music: A contemplative piano piece that shifts in key and mood with each season — light and hopeful in spring, warm and full in summer, melancholic in autumn, and sparse and crystalline in winter.

templates.prompt:

<Picture 1>@Picture 1 is the ONLY appearance source — shape / identity / face / body / texture MUST be copied EXACTLY, never redesigned, never swapped.

<Picture 2>@Picture 2 (optional) is the background source — IF provided, the whole scene / environment / lighting / atmosphere come from it EXACTLY.
(b) Picture 1 is the only source of appearance, and the main shape/identity/face/body/mass/mass must be fully copied and re-engineered or replaced; Video 1 is the only source of action, and the subject must take the action of video 1 from frame to frame (attitude/temperature/trajector/velocity), strictly forbidden; Picture 2 is an optional background source, which must be provided strictly from Picture 2 and self-inflicted backgrounds are prohibited.

[IRON RULE — NO HUMAN WHEN REFERENCES CONTAIN NO PERSON — ]:
When ALL reference pictures contain ONLY objects and NO human, the output MUST NOT contain ANY human figure — not as subject, not in background, not as passer-by, not as silhouette; NEVER a face, NEVER clothes, NEVER a tree-man / plant-human / costumed character. The video shows ONLY a particle swarm made of the object (s) from the reference pictures: countless discrete, separate particles (leaves / grains) freely floating, irregularly scattered, with clear GAPS between them, no fixed shape. IRON RULE — the particles MUST keep clear gaps between one another; particle density MUST be low and sparse; the LARGER the gaps between particles, the BETTER — each particle floats alone in visible space, never clumping into a tight mass. The swarm has NO body / limbs / head / face / clothing / skin / humanoid structure and NEVER assembles into a human-like shape. It ONLY follows the MOTION of <Video 1>@1 (pattern / trajectory / rhythm / tempo as one body); NOTHING else — no silhouette, no shape, no appearance, no scene — is taken from <Video 1>. The person / object from <Video 1> must NEVER be generated directly. Under no circumstance does a person appear when the references show objects only.
All references except objects, without caractors, the output is determined not to appear any caractor image - subject/background/walker/cutshot; There is no face, no clothes, no tree/plant/outfit role. The video presents only particles that have been transformed from a reference object: numerous discrete particles (leaves/particles) float freely, spread irregularly, and there must be a clear gap between particles, with no fixed shape. Iron law - there must be a clear gap between particles and particles and density must be small and thin; The larger the gap between particles, the better, each particle floats independently in the visible space and never gathers in close clusters. Particle clusters have no body/temperature/head/face/outfit/skin, no artificial structure, and are never congregate into human shapes. Particle clusters follow only the actions of video 1 as a whole (mode/trajector/temperature/velocity), without reference to the contours/form/scene of video 1; Never directly generate character or object in video 1.

[SUBJECT-TYPE MATCHING — 4 CASES]:
Case 1 — <Video 1>@1 shows a HUMAN action: the subject (person or animal) performs the EXACT same action — same poses, limb motion, timing, gait, sequence; if animal, perform with its own body keeping every key pose.
Case 2 — <Video 1>@1 shows an ANIMAL action: the subject performs the EXACT same action — same motion pattern, jumping / running / rolling rhythm, poses, locomotion.

【参考层级·绝对强制】图1是用户的任意图片——唯一的渐变起点：其主体/构图/机位/光线在开头完全照抄，并作为整段视频的结构锚点。可以是任何图片——街道、建筑、室内、车辆、风景、产品、人物场景，画面中的一切都会衰败并被野草吞噬。图2（可选）为荒芜风格参考：提供时，最终荒野的植被种类/衰败程度/色调遵循图2；未提供时使用默认的茂密野草丛生风格（高草、粗藤、苔藓）。图3（可选）为额外场景参考：弱参考，只补充环境细节。

[MORPH BRIDGE / 渐变桥梁铁律 — ONE CONTINUOUS MORPH]:
The whole video is ONE continuous, seamless morph from <Picture 1>@图1's original look to a full post-apocalyptic overgrown wasteland — no cuts, no hard transitions, no teleport, no sudden jumps. The camera path of the source image is continued; the composition and the subject's silhouette stay anchored and readable throughout.
Time axis (12s): [0-4s] the original image stays almost unchanged, only the first decay signals appear (a crack in the asphalt / a few green shoots / slightly faded colors); [4-8s] overgrowth spreads: weeds push through the ground, vines climb and cover surfaces, moss and lichen spread, paint peels, rust blooms — the original scene visibly decays IN PLACE; [8-12s] total wasteland: dense wild grass and creepers swallow the scene, the original subject is recognizable only by its silhouette and position, the world becomes a wild overgrown ruin. The morph rate is smooth and continuous — every intermediate frame is a natural in-between state.
【渐变桥梁铁律·单一连续变形】整段视频是从图1原貌到彻底末日荒芜野草丛生的单一连续无缝渐变——无剪辑、无硬切、无瞬移、无突跳。延续源图片的镜头路径；构图与主体轮廓全程锚定、始终可辨。
时间轴（12s）：[0-4s] 原图几乎不变，只出现最初的衰败信号（路面一道裂缝/几点新绿/颜色微微褪去）；[4-8s] 野草蔓延：杂草顶裂地面、藤蔓攀爬覆盖表面、苔藓与地衣扩散、油漆剥落、锈迹蔓延——原场景原地可见地衰败；[8-12s] 彻底荒芜：茂密野草与藤蔓吞没场景，原图主体仅凭轮廓与位置仍可辨认，世界成为野草丛生的荒芜废墟。渐变速率平滑连续——每一个中间帧都是自然的过渡态。

[APOCALYPSE VISUAL / 末日视觉铁律]:
Wild tall grass cracking through the ground, thick vines and creepers climbing and covering walls / roofs / vehicles, moss and lichen spreading over every surface, vines hanging like curtains from broken windows and ledges, paint peeling, concrete crumbling, metal rusting, scattered debris and dust, thin fog and atmospheric haze, sunrays breaking through clouds (soft diffused light), colors fading to desaturated yellow-brown / grey-green wasteland tones. Atmosphere: desolate, silent, nature reclaims civilization — time has passed long after humans.
【末日视觉铁律】野草疯长顶裂地面，粗壮藤蔓攀爬覆盖墙壁/屋顶/车辆，苔藓与地衣蔓延至每个表面，藤蔓自破碎窗沿垂下如帘，油漆剥落、混凝土碎裂、金属锈蚀，遍地碎砾与尘土，薄雾与大气霾，阳光穿透云层（柔和漫射光），色调褪为低饱和黄褐/灰绿荒芜色。氛围：荒凉、寂静、自然吞噬文明——人类消失已久的时间感。

[FINAL STATE / 终点锁定]:
By the final frame the transformation is COMPLETE: the scene is a fully overgrown post-apocalyptic wasteland; the original subject is reduced to a silhouette buried in dense vegetation and decay. Do NOT stop halfway; do NOT reverse / recover; do NOT show any living humans or clean surviving areas.
【终点锁定】最后一帧渐变必须完成：画面成为完全野草丛生的末日荒芜景象；原图主体被茂密植被与衰败吞没、只剩轮廓。不得半途而止；不得逆向恢复；不得出现任何活人或完好/未衰败的区域。

The original subject's silhouette and position stay anchored and recognizable. The final frame is a complete post-apocalyptic overgrown wasteland. No humans, no dialogue, no subtitles.

Wind over the overgrowth, dry grass rustling, faint creaks of crumbling structures, distant bird calls; NO speech, NO dialogue, NO voice-over by default.
荒原风声、干草沙沙、建筑崩塌的细微吱呀、远处鸟鸣；默认无说话、无对白、无旁白。

A low, desolate ambient score with a slow swell as the wasteland takes over; subtle, restrained.
低沉荒凉氛围配乐，随荒芜吞噬渐强；克制、压低。

3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit.
4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle between hits, no mindless flailing ("王八拳").
5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue — never talk while striking or the video degrades to slow-motion flailing.
6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.
【武打动作铁律·重量与结果】1) 具体招式：每个招式都必须用具体的武术术语命名（"扫堂腿"✔，绝不写笼统的"踢腿"✘）——提示词决定"怎么打"，必须明确。2) 命中反馈：每次有效攻击都有真实冲击——接触瞬间皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土飞溅；冲击必须有重量感。3) 身体反应：被击者身体诚实反应——甩头、后仰踉跄、躯干回弹、屈膝、后退回稳；绝不出现无反应的挨打。4) 连续逻辑：攻防是连续逻辑链——攻击→命中/落空→反应→反击；两人之间不瞬移、不重置回站立、不乱挥拳。5) 动作先于台词：同一镜头中必须完整完成击打动作后再说话——绝不边打边说，否则视频会退化为慢动作乱挥。6) 收尾明确：战斗以明确结果结束——决定性命中、KO、武器脱手或互相停手，绝不无疾而终。

[COMBAT TRIGGER WORDS / 战斗触发词]: Use the H3 Combat LoRA trigger words when the workflow supports them: prfight1 (normal fight) always; add prfin1 when the fight needs a decisive KO/finish; add prslow1 (with an explicit slow-motion sentence) when the final blow should slow down on impact. 使用 H3 Combat LoRA 触发词（工作流支持时）：普通战斗必用 prfight1；需要决定性终结/KO 时追加 prfin1；需要最后一击命中瞬间慢动作时再追加 prslow1（并明确写出慢动作句子）。

[HIT FEEDBACK MASTERY / 命中反馈专精 — THE RESULT OF EVERY STRIKE]:
Every effective strike must show what REALLY happened after the blow:
1) CONTACT MICRO-MOMENT: at the instant of impact — skin/fabric/muscle ripple at the contact point, sweat or dust burst, hair/clothing whip from the force.
2) BODY DISPLACEMENT: the struck fighter is visibly displaced by the force — head snaps back, torso recoils, feet slide or lift, body rotates from the blow's direction; never absorb a hit standing still.
3) STAGGER & RECOVERY: after a heavy hit the struck fighter staggers (backward steps, knee dip, hands out for balance) and recovers with visible effort (wobble, shake head, reset stance) — the recovery IS part of the fight.
4) STRIKE CONSEQUENCE: each effective attack has a concrete consequence — opponent pushed back, knocked down, weapon dropped, furniture/object broken, or ring ropes/crowd reaction; if it hits nothing, it is visibly dodged/blocked (blocked hits show the guard absorbing force, arm jarring).
5) WEIGHT SCALE: light hits cause small flinches, heavy hits cause falls — the weight of the blow matches the size of the reaction.
【命中反馈专精·每一击的结果】每次有效攻击都必须呈现击中后的真实后果：1) 接触微瞬间：命中瞬间接触点皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土爆开、头发/衣物被冲击力甩动。2) 身体位移：被击者被力明显位移——甩头、躯干回弹、脚底滑动或离地、身体沿击打方向转动；绝不站定硬吃一击。3) 踉跄与恢复：重击后被击者踉跄（后退、屈膝、伸手保持平衡），并带着可见的努力恢复（晃动、甩头、重置架势）——恢复本身就是战斗的一部分。4) 攻击后果：每次有效攻击都有具体后果——对手被推退、击倒、武器脱手、撞碎家具/道具、观众/围绳反应；未命中则被明确躲开/格挡（格挡显示防线吸收力量、手臂被震开）。5) 重量匹配：轻击引发小抽动，重击引发倒地——打击重量与反应幅度匹配。

- 8.5–10.0s: 解冻收尾。摄影机完成 360 度环绕后停在<Subject 1>正面，时间开始缓慢恢复——悬浮物开始下坠/飘散，<Subject 1>动作继续完成。画面稳定流畅，无肢体畸形、无多指。

- 1.5s: 瞬间凝固。冲击达到最大飞溅形态的瞬间时间冻结——所有飞溅物悬浮定格在半空：水珠成串悬停、玻璃碎片棱角分明地静止、纸张在空中展开、碎屑与尘土铺开成扇形/环形。每个飞溅物都清晰可辨，写明材质/形状/颜色（如：半透明的水珠、边缘锐利的玻璃碎片、发光的火花）。
- 1.5–8.5s: 凝固 + 弧线环绕。时间完全静止，摄影机沿水平弧线环绕飞溅中心约180-240度并缓慢推近，恒定半径匀速；前景碎屑、主体、背景三层视差滑动。时间切片摄影效果：仿佛高速相机阵列从多个角度同时拍摄，同一凝固瞬间的多角度呈现。画面等效1/8000s高快门：水珠圆润锐利、碎片边缘无运动模糊、火花光芒清晰、无拖影无重影。
- 8.5–10.0s: 解冻收尾。摄影机停在<Subject 1>侧面，时间缓慢恢复——飞溅物开始下落/回落，水花坠地、碎片落地叮当。画面稳定流畅，无肢体畸形、无多指。

overall_soundscape:
冲击的爆裂声在凝固瞬间骤停，凝固期寂静只有环绕气流声，解冻瞬间水花/碎片落地声恢复。

non_diegetic_music:
冲击瞬间一声紧凑重音，凝固瞬间音乐骤停一拍，随后低频脉冲心跳式节拍+空灵弦乐垫，突出时间凝滞，收尾时短促低频重击。

- 0.0–1.5s: <Subject 1>被包围在中心，正面一名反派率先出拳，<Subject 1>侧身闪避同时反击直拳。就在<Subject 1>与正面<Subject 2>对招时，侧面一名反派偷袭出拳，<Subject 1>用眼角余光察觉，低头闪避，拳头从头顶掠过。
- 1.5–3.0s: 视觉群殴展开——<Subject 1>同时应对来自正面、侧面、身后的多路攻击。正面反派出拳，<Subject 1>格挡反击；侧面反派踢腿，<Subject 1>转身格开；身后反派偷袭，<Subject 1>头也不回肘击反击。机位不断变化，展示主角被全方位攻击的压迫感。
- 3.0–4.5s: <Subject 1>利用环境道具——抓起旁边的椅子格挡多路攻击，椅子腿挡住拳打脚踢，同时用椅子撞击最近的反派，将其撞退。另一名反派从高处跳下攻击，<Subject 1>侧身闪避，反派摔在地上。
- 4.5–6.0s: <Subject 1>连续快攻——先击倒正面反派，转身踢倒侧面反派，再用擒拿技锁住身后反派的手臂将其摔倒。但更多反派涌上来，<Subject 1>体力开始下降，呼吸粗重动作变慢。
- 6.0–7.5s: 反派抓住<Subject 1>体力下降的机会，同时从三个方向攻击——正面拳打、侧面腿踢、身后抱腰。<Subject 1>被抱住腰部无法移动，正面反派一拳击中<Subject 1>面部，<Subject 1>头被打得偏向一侧。
- 7.5–9.0s: <Subject 1>暴怒爆发——头槌撞击抱腰反派的鼻子，抱腰反派松手后退。<Subject 1>转身连续快拳击倒正面反派，侧踢击倒侧面反派，再一个旋风踢扫倒刚爬起来的反派。剩下的反派不敢上前，围在周围犹豫。
- 9.0–10.0s: <Subject 1>站立在倒地的反派中间，呼吸粗重汗水飞溅，目光扫过周围剩余的反派，摆出戒备姿态。画面稳定流畅，无肢体畸形，无闪烁跳帧。

overall_soundscape: 拳打脚踢的密集击打声，椅子格挡的碰撞声，环境道具破碎声，反派的喊叫声，主角的粗重喘息声，衣料挥动声，地面摩擦声。

templates.description: The 18-minute one-take police-station melee style of "Fire Covering the Eyes". Zero effects, zero stunt doubles, zero fast cuts: the long take clings to the lead, watching him hold on by willpower through a relay of attackers while exhausted and battered. The suffocating tension is pushed to the maximum.

- 6.0–8.0s: 战阵推进——<Subject 1>方的长矛方阵稳步推进，长矛如林，敌方步兵被长矛阵逼退。刀盾兵在长矛阵前方开路，盾牌格挡敌方攻击，短刀从盾下刺出。弓箭手在后方持续射击，压制敌方后阵。
- 8.0–10.0s: 敌方阵线崩溃——<Subject 1>方全军冲锋，战鼓声达到最高潮，士兵们呐喊着冲向溃退的敌军。摄影机跟随一名士兵冲锋，他举着长矛越过倒地的敌人，军旗在他身后飘扬。大远景拉开展示整个战场的胜利场面。画面稳定流畅，无肢体畸形。

【武打动作铁律·重量与结果】1) 具体招式：每个招式都必须用具体的武术术语命名（"扫堂腿"✔，绝不写笼统的"踢腿"✘）——提示词决定"怎么打"，必须明确。2) 命中反馈：每次有效攻击都有真实冲击——接触瞬间皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土飞溅；冲击必须有重量感。3) 身体反应：被击者身体诚实反应——甩头、后仰踉跄、躯干回弹、屈膝、后退回稳；绝不出现无反应的挨打。4) 连续逻辑：攻防是连续逻辑链——攻击→命中/落空→反应→反击；两人之间不瞬移、不重置回站立、不乱挥拳。5) 动作先于台词：同一镜头中必须完整完成击打动作后再说话——绝不边打边说，否则视频会退化为慢动作乱挥。6) 收尾明确：战斗以明确结果结束——决定性命中、KO、武器脱手或互相停手，绝不无疾而终。

[REFERENCE IMAGES ARE THE SOLE TRUTH / 参考图是唯一真相 — ABSOLUTE MANDATE]: The model MUST copy the reference images directly. Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. The fighter in <Picture 1>@图1 MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 1>@图1 — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 1>@图1. The fighter in <Picture 2>@图2 MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 2>@图2 — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 2>@图2. If only ONE reference figure is provided, the opponent is a matching fighter of the same visual world, clearly distinct from the reference figure. <Picture 3>@图3 (optional) = fight location, strict. When @图3 is provided, the environment, lighting and scale come entirely from <Picture 3>@图3 and must be preserved exactly. When @图3 is NOT provided, the model automatically generates a fitting battle scene of the same visual world as the two fighters. 【参考图是唯一真相·绝对强制】模型必须直接复制参考图：图1人物必须与图1完全一致（脸/发型/服装/体型/武器/气场）；图2人物必须与图2完全一致；只提供一张参考人物图时，对手是同视觉世界且明显不同的匹配武者；图3（可选）为打斗场景，提供时严格遵循其环境/灯光/比例，未提供时由模型自动生成与两人同世界的对战场景。

[FIGHT IRON RULES / 武打动作铁律 — WEIGHT & RESULT]:
1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology, never vague wording — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit.
2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT.
3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit.
4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle, no mindless flailing.
5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue.
6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.
【武打动作铁律·重量与结果】1) 具体招式：每个招式都用具体武术术语命名，绝不笼统。2) 命中反馈：每次有效攻击都有真实冲击——接触瞬间皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土飞溅，冲击有重量感。3) 身体反应：被击者诚实反应——甩头、后仰踉跄、躯干回弹、屈膝、后退回稳；绝不无反应挨打。4) 连续逻辑：攻防是连续逻辑链——攻击→命中/落空→反应→反击，不瞬移、不重置回站立、不乱挥拳。5) 动作先于台词：同一镜头先完整完成击打动作再说话。6) 收尾明确：战斗以明确结果结束——决定性命中、KO、武器脱手或互相停手。

[COMBAT TRIGGER WORDS / 战斗触发词]: Use the H3 Combat LoRA trigger words when the workflow supports them: prfight1 (normal fight) always; add prfin1 when the fight needs a decisive KO/finish; add prslow1 (with an explicit slow-motion sentence) when the final blow should slow down on impact. 使用 H3 Combat LoRA 触发词（工作流支持时）：普通战斗必用 prfight1；需要决定性终结/KO 时追加 prfin1；需要最后一击命中瞬间慢动作时再追加 prslow1（并明确写出慢动作句子）。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-8s] 单一连续战斗镜头。图1武者与图2武者对打（场景：图3提供时严格使用图3，未提供时由模型自动生成与人物同世界的格斗对战场景）。本招式专精「回旋踢」：回旋踢 ｜ 半跪在地，单手撑住地面稳住身形，镜头低角度仰拍。 ｜ 以撑地手掌为支点，腰部发力翻身，双腿在空中回旋。 ｜ 极速慢动作定格，翻身回旋踢（AerialRoundhouseKick）脚背扫向脖颈。 ｜ 命中冲击特写，脚背扫中颈部，颈部受冲击，身体横向摔飞。。全程遵守武打铁律——每次攻击接触瞬间有震颤与汗水/尘土飞溅，被击者身体诚实位移（甩头/后仰/踉跄/屈膝），重击后带可见踉跄与恢复，每次有效攻击都有具体后果，轻重攻击反应幅度匹配，攻防为连续逻辑链不打断，动作先于台词。若需终结：最后一击决定性命中→对手明显失衡→击倒/脱手收尾（prfight1, prfin1；需要慢镜终结时加 prslow1 并明确'最后一击命中瞬间进入短暂慢动作再恢复'）。

overall_soundscape:
每一击的闷响都有重量差异（轻击脆响、重击沉闷震动），命中瞬间的肌肉受击声、汗水/尘土飞溅声，被击者踉跄的脚步声与呼吸声，脚步移动的擦地声，招式发力时的破空声，以及最终决定性命中或击倒时的冲击声与地面震动。无对白。

non_diegetic_music:
克制而有力的打击乐配乐，鼓点跟随每一击——重击时低频鼓点加重，命中瞬间配短促重音，攻防僵持段音乐压低，收尾定格时配一个干净有力的终止音。

The fighter in <Picture 1> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 1> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 1>. The fighter in <Picture 2> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 2> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 2>. If only ONE reference figure is provided, the opponent is a matching fighter of the same visual world, clearly distinct from the reference figure. <Picture 3> (optional) = fight location, strict. When is provided, the environment, lighting and scale come entirely from <Picture 3> and must be preserved exactly. [FIGHT IRON RULES — WEIGHT & RESULT]: 1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology, never vague wording — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit. 2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT. 3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit. 4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle, no mindless flailing. 5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue. 6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.

The fighter in <Picture 1>@Picture 1 duels the fighter in <Picture 2>@Picture 2 (when <Picture 3>@Picture 3 is provided the scene follows <Picture 3>@Picture 3 exactly; otherwise the model generates a fitting duel scene in the same visual world). This move specializes in Kick and Throw to Death:  Want to kick me? I'll throw you to death ｜ <Picture 1>@Picture 1 Warrior sidesteps forward, delivering a sharp side kick heavy strike to <Picture 2>@Picture 2 warrior's ribs, camera ｜ medium shot lateral movement capturing the linear explosive force. ｜ <Picture 2>@Picture 2 warrior initiates right mid-sweep counterattack, <Picture 1>@Picture 1 warrior lowers right arm to scoop and grapple <Picture 2>@Picture 2 warrior ｜ <Picture 1>@Picture 1 warrior follows up by diving down, hooking <Picture 2>@Picture 2 warrior's supporting leg, straightening torso upward to lift the entire person from the picture ｜ throw them into a flip slam, camera tilts upward to capture <Picture 2>@Picture 2 warrior flying horizontally in mid-air with weightlessness. ｜ <Picture 2>@Picture 2 warrior lands heavily flat on the center of the ring mat, <Picture 1>@Picture 1 warrior retracts leg and displays open palm ｜ retreats back into fighting stance, camera pulls back to cut to main referee raising hand to signal. ｜ Throughout, honor the fight iron rules: on every contact there is a tremor and sweat/dust spray; the struck body reacts honestly (head snap / backward stagger / knee buckle / step-back); heavy blows leave a visible stagger and recovery; every effective strike has a concrete consequence; light and heavy reactions match the force; the attack/defense chain stays continuous and unbroken; action precedes dialogue. templates.prompt:

The fighter in <Picture 1> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 1> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 1>. The fighter in <Picture 2> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 2> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 2>. If only ONE reference figure is provided, the opponent is a matching fighter of the same visual world, clearly distinct from the reference figure. <Picture 3> (optional) = fight location, strict. When is provided, the environment, lighting and scale come entirely from <Picture 3> and must be preserved exactly. When is NOT provided, the model automatically generates a fitting battle scene of the same visual world as the two fighters.

Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. The fighter in <Picture 1> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 1> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 1>. The fighter in <Picture 2> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 2> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 2>. If only ONE reference figure is provided, the opponent is a matching fighter of the same visual world, clearly distinct from the reference figure. <Picture 3> (optional) = fight location, strict. When is provided, the environment, lighting and scale come entirely from <Picture 3> and must be preserved exactly. When is NOT provided, the model automatically generates a fitting battle scene of the same visual world as the two fighters.

[FIGHT IRON RULES — WEIGHT & RESULT]: 1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology, never vague wording — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit. 2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT. 3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit. 4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle, no mindless flailing. 5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue. 6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.

[COMBAT TRIGGER WORDS ]: Use the H3 Combat LoRA trigger words when the workflow supports them: prfight1 (normal fight) always; add prfin1 when the fight needs a decisive KO/finish; add prslow1 (with an explicit slow-motion sentence) when the final blow should slow down on impact.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-8s] One continuous fight shot. The fighter in <Picture 1>@Picture 1 duels the fighter in <Picture 2>@Picture 2 (when <Picture 3>@Picture 3 is provided the scene follows <Picture 3>@Picture 3 exactly; otherwise the model generates a fitting duel scene in the same visual world). This move specializes in Move 13:  sidestep slip with magic afterimage, weight shifts sharply sideways, smi- ｜ transparent ghost silhouette lingers at old position then fades, immediately ｜ counters with quick palm strike ｜ low ducking shuffle with fading afterimage streaks, drops center of gravity ｜ slides sideways along ground, stacked ghost silhouettes trace sliding path, ｜ rises instantly to throw elbow ｜ pivot evade with magic afterimage, spins on front foot, ghost silhouette ｜ remains at prior stance, reposition to opponent's flank, launches counter ｜ punch ｜ Throughout, honor the fight iron rules: on every contact there is a tremor and sweat/dust spray; the struck body reacts honestly (head snap / backward stagger / knee buckle / step-back); heavy blows leave a visible stagger and recovery; every effective strike has a concrete consequence; light and heavy reactions match the force; the attack/defense chain stays continuous and unbroken; action precedes dialogue. If a finish is needed: decisive final hit -> clear imbalance -> knockdown/weapon-drop finish (prfight1, prfin1; add prslow1 for a slow-motion finish and explicitly state 'the final blow enters a brief slow motion before resuming').

overall_soundscape:
Every impact has a distinct weight: light strikes make a crisp snap, heavy blows a dull thud. On contact you hear the muscle hit, sweat/dust spray, the struck fighter's staggering footfalls and breath, the scrape of footwork, the whoosh of a committed strike, and finally the shockwave and ground tremor of the decisive hit or takedown. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
Restrained, forceful percussive score; the drums follow every strike — low-frequency emphasis on heavy blows, a short accent on each hit, the score pulled back during the clinch, and one clean, strong cadence on the final freeze.

Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. The fighter in <Picture 1> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 1> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 1>. The fighter in <Picture 2> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 2> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 2>. If only ONE reference figure is provided, the opponent is a matching fighter of the same visual world, clearly distinct from the reference figure. <Picture 3> (optional) = fight location, strict. When is provided, the environment, lighting and scale come entirely from <Picture 3> and must be preserved exactly. When is NOT provided, the model automatically generates a fitting battle scene of the same visual world as the two fighters.

[FIGHT IRON RULES — WEIGHT & RESULT]: 1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology, never vague wording — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit. 2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT. 3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit. 4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle, no mindless flailing. 5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue. 6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.

[COMBAT TRIGGER WORDS ]: Use the H3 Combat LoRA trigger words when the workflow supports them: prfight1 (normal fight) always; add prfin1 when the fight needs a decisive KO/finish; add prslow1 (with an explicit slow-motion sentence) when the final blow should slow down on impact.

overall_soundscape:
每一击的闷响都有重量差异（轻击脆响、重击沉闷震动），命中瞬间的肌肉受击声、汗水/尘土飞溅声，被击者踉跄的脚步声与呼吸声，脚步移动的擦地声，招式发力时的破空声，以及最终决定性命中或击倒时的冲击声与地面震动。无对白。

non_diegetic_music:
克制而有力的打击乐配乐，鼓点跟随每一击——重击时低频鼓点加重，命中瞬间配短促重音，攻防僵持段音乐压低，收尾定格时配一个干净有力的终止音。

On contact you hear the muscle hit, sweat/dust spray, the struck fighter's staggering footfalls and breath, the scrape of footwork, the whoosh of a committed strike, and finally the shockwave and ground tremor of the decisive hit or takedown. No dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
Restrained, forceful percussive score; the drums follow every strike — low-frequency emphasis on heavy blows, a short accent on each hit, the score pulled back during the clinch, and one clean, strong cadence on the final freeze.

When @图3 is NOT provided, the model automatically generates a fitting battle scene of the same visual world as the two fighters. 【参考图是唯一真相·绝对强制】模型必须直接复制参考图：图1人物必须与图1完全一致（脸/发型/服装/体型/武器/气场）；图2人物必须与图2完全一致；只提供一张参考人物图时，对手是同视觉世界且明显不同的匹配武者；图3（可选）为打斗场景，提供时严格遵循其环境/灯光/比例，未提供时由模型自动生成与两人同世界的对战场景。

Do NOT invent, improvise, guess, hallucinate, or 'improve' any face, hairstyle, outfit, color, pattern, fabric, body type, accessory, or prop that is not explicitly shown in the connected <Picture N> reference images. The fighter in <Picture 1> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 1> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 1>. The fighter in <Picture 2> MUST look exactly like the person in <Picture 2> — same face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, weapon and personal energy, all from <Picture 2>. If only ONE reference figure is provided, the opponent is a matching fighter of the same visual world, clearly distinct from the reference figure. <Picture 3> (optional) = fight location, strict. When is provided, the environment, lighting and scale come entirely from <Picture 3> and must be preserved exactly. When is NOT provided, the model automatically generates a fitting battle scene of the same visual world as the two fighters.

[FIGHT IRON RULES — WEIGHT & RESULT]: 1) CONCRETE MOVES: name every technique with SPECIFIC martial-arts terminology, never vague wording — the prompt decides HOW they fight, so be explicit. 2) HIT FEEDBACK: every effective strike shows real impact — the contact moment has skin/fabric/muscle ripple, sweat or dust spray; the impact reads with WEIGHT. 3) BODY REACTION: the struck fighter's body reacts honestly — head snap, backward stagger, torso recoil, knee buckle, step-back recovery; never a no-reaction hit. 4) CONTINUOUS LOGIC: the exchange is a continuous logical chain — attack → hit/miss → reaction → counter; no teleporting, no resetting to idle, no mindless flailing. 5) ACTION BEFORE DIALOGUE: in the same shot, ALWAYS complete the strike sequence first, THEN any dialogue. 6) ENDING: the fight ends with a clear result — decisive hit, KO, weapon drop, or mutual pause — never a fade-to-nothing.

【武打动作铁律·重量与结果】1) 具体招式：每个招式都用具体武术术语命名，绝不笼统。2) 命中反馈：每次有效攻击都有真实冲击——接触瞬间皮肤/衣料/肌肉震颤、汗水或尘土飞溅，冲击有重量感。3) 身体反应：被击者诚实反应——甩头、后仰踉跄、躯干回弹、屈膝、后退回稳；绝不无反应挨打。4) 连续逻辑：攻防是连续逻辑链——攻击→命中/落空→反应→反击，不瞬移、不重置回站立、不乱挥拳。5) 动作先于台词：同一镜头先完整完成击打动作再说话。6) 收尾明确：战斗以明确结果结束——决定性命中、KO、武器脱手或互相停手。

templates.description:
Convert an anime or illustration character into a hyperreal photo of a real person, keeping the composition and character features, with extremely realistic skin texture and natural human proportions. 

[IMPORTANT: this template must use Reference to Video mode with two images uploaded] 
- Picture 1 = the anime image (supplies content, composition, pose, outfit layout) 
- Picture 2 = the real-person image (supplies facial identity, skin texture, the live-action style baseline) 

[HOW TO USE - three generation modes] 

Mode 1: Text to Video 
- No images needed, the live-action video is generated purely from the text description 
- Describe the character's looks, outfit, scene and action under Additional edits 
- Result: the look is decided by the text, not converted from a specific anime image 

Mode 2: Image to Video - NOT recommended for a full anime-to-real conversion 
- Upload the anime image as the first frame 
- Limited result: I2V holds the anime style of the first frame strongly and struggles to fully convert to live action 
- Only use it to make an anime image move slightly, not for a full anime-to-real conversion 

Mode 3: Reference to Video - RECOMMENDED, the real way to do anime-to-real 
- Upload two reference images: 
- Picture 1 = the anime image (content, composition, pose, outfit) 
- Picture 2 = the real-person image (facial identity, skin texture, style baseline) 
- Result: best. The anime content provides the structure, the real photo injects its face and photorealistic style 
- Tip: pick a real photo whose gender, age and hairstyle are close to the anime character 

[SUGGESTED SETTINGS] 
- Duration: 3-6 seconds (shorter clips convert style more stably) 
- Turn face restore off (face_restore=Off) when upscaling, otherwise frame-by-frame repair causes ghosting and flicker

templates.description_zh:
将动漫/插画角色转换为超写实真人照片，保留构图与角色特征，极致真实皮肤纹理与自然人体比例。

【重要：本模板必须使用「参考生视频 (Reference to Video)」模式，上传两张图】
  • Picture 1 = 动漫图（提供内容、构图、姿势、服装布局）
  • Picture 2 = 真人图（提供脸部身份、皮肤纹理、真人风格基准）

【使用说明 — 三种生成模式】

▎模式1：文生视频 (Text to Video)
• 无需上传图片，纯靠文字描述生成真人视频
• 在"补充修改"中描述角色外貌、服装、场景和动作
• 效果：角色外观由文字决定，不是从特定动漫图转换

▎模式2：图生视频 (Image to Video) ⚠️ 不推荐用于完全转真人
• 上传动漫图片作为第一帧
• 效果有限！I2V会强烈保持第一帧的动漫风格，很难完全转为真人
• 仅用于让动漫图轻微动起来，不建议用于完全的动漫转真人

▎模式3：参考生视频 (Reference to Video) ✅ 【推荐】真正实现动漫转真人
• 上传两张参考图：
  - Picture 1 = 动漫图（内容/构图/姿势/服装参考）
  - Picture 2 = 真人图（脸部身份/皮肤纹理/风格基准）
• 效果：最好！以动漫图内容为骨架，注入真人图脸部和写实风格
• 技巧：真人参考图尽量选择与动漫角色性别、年龄、发型相近的真人照片

【参数建议】
• 时长：3-6秒（短时长风格转换更稳定）
• 超分放大时请关闭人脸修复（face_restore=Off），避免逐帧修复导致鬼影闪烁
