[Shot 2] [1-4s] A gradual, seamless photorealistic transformation unfolds from the edges of the frame inward toward the center — not an abrupt switch, but a smooth dissolve-like morph with no hard boundaries. At 1-2s, the outermost edges (background corners, hair tips, clothing hems, prop edges) begin to gain real-world texture, natural lighting, and physical material properties while the center remains fully anime. At 2-3s, realistic texturing spreads inward through the midground — the scene and background gain real depth and atmospheric perspective matching <Picture 1>@图1's exact layout, the clothing gains real fabric/material texture and proper physical folds matching <Picture 1>@图1's exact outfit, the hair gains individual strands and natural sheen while keeping the EXACT color, length, and style from <Picture 1>@图1, accessories gain real material properties matching <Picture 1>@图1. The face remains in a half-anime half-real hybrid state during this transition — eye size gradually reduces from anime proportions toward natural human proportions matching the facial reference above, skin gradually gains subtle pores and texture while keeping the skin tone from the facial reference above. At 3-4s, the transformation completes at the center — the face fully transitions to the real human features from the facial reference above (eye shape and size, nose structure, lip contour, jawline, skin texture and tone), while the expression, gaze direction, and head angle match <Picture 1>@图1 exactly. Throughout the entire transformation, the clothing, scene, pose, composition, hairstyle, hair color, and accessories all remain exactly as in <Picture 1>@图1.

[Shot 3] [4-8s] The fully photorealistic character moves naturally within the exact scene from <Picture 1>@图1. Hair (matching <Picture 1>@图1's color and style) sways softly in a light breeze. The character blinks naturally and makes a slight head turn while preserving <Picture 1>@图1's overall pose. The chest rises and falls with calm breathing beneath the clothing from <Picture 1>@图1. Realistic light shifts across the skin, hair, and clothing materials from <Picture 1>@图1. The camera slowly pushes in slightly. The overall look is cinematic live-action realism — shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, professional portrait lighting, shot on an 85mm prime lens, natural color grading, 8K quality. The outfit, scene, pose, hair, and accessories all remain exactly as in <Picture 1>@图1; only the face is from the facial reference above.

overall_soundscape:
A soft whoosh during the style transition, then natural ambient sounds matching the environment from <Picture 1>@图1 — gentle wind, subtle fabric rustle, appropriate environmental atmosphere.

non_diegetic_music:
A warm cinematic score that builds from soft piano during the transformation into lush strings, conveying the quiet wonder of an anime character stepping into reality.
templates.description_zh:
将动漫/插画角色转换为超写实真人，首帧严格来自动漫图，服装/场景/发色/姿势完全保留，仅风格真人化+脸部替换为描述的真人特征。

【使用方法 — 必须配合 v1.5 工作流】
1. 加载 v1.5 工作流（不是v1.4！v1.5已断开last_frame避免转场）
2. 模式选择「图生视频 (Image to Video)」
3. 图1上传动漫图（作为首帧，提供服装/场景/姿势/发色）
4. 图2上传真人图（仅用于参考，v1.5已断开图2到模型的连接）
5. 在提示词的 FACIAL REFERENCE 区域，把 [在此详细填写...] 替换为真人图的脸部特征描述（越详细越好）
6. 运行

【为什么不用双图参考生视频】
ReferenceToVideo 模式本质是两张图之间的转场融合，会导致最终变成真人图的服装/场景/发型（已验证失败）。I2V首帧模式只有动漫图作为起点，从根本上避免转场问题。

【为什么脸部用文字描述而不是图片】
I2V模式只接受一张首帧图。真人图不连接模型，仅作为用户参考，脸部特征通过文字描述注入。这样模型不会被真人图的服装/场景干扰。

If the user has not entered any text yet, STOP and ask them to enter the text first (the template output without user text is only a placeholder). [·]"" — ；；，， This template itself contains NO hard-coded on-screen text — every character that appears on screen is the user’s text from “”. [TYPOGRAPHY IRON RULES]:
1) ACCURACY: every character of the user text appears on screen — zero typos, zero garbled glyphs, zero missing Chinese characters, zero auto-replaced words.
2) READABILITY: the text stays bold, high-contrast, with clean edges at ALL times; animation may be dramatic but NEVER distorts a character beyond readability.
3) UNIFIED TYPE: one consistent font family throughout the whole video; no font switching mid-shot.
4) SINGLE ACCENT: palette = white/black base + ONE accent color (default #FF3B30 red-orange, or follow <Picture 2>@Picture 2 if provided); never rainbow-multicolor unless the style says so.
5) BEAT-SYNC: text movement, entrance and hold timing lock to the music beat / rhythm; every entrance lands ON a beat, no off-beat drift.
6) CLEAN MOTION: animations are smooth, no stutter, no jitter, no flicker, no clipping; easing is natural (ease-out entrances, crisp holds).
7) LAYOUT: generous margins, no text collision, no screen-edge cropping; when <Picture 1>@Picture 1 is present, text never permanently covers the subject's face.
Accurate: Text-by-word - Zero error, random code, Zero missing words, Zero automatic replacement. 2) Readability: text is highly contrasted and edged; kinetic effects can be intense but never distort to unreadable. 3) Harmonization of fonts: The same font family for the entire journey (Chinese bold bold/English rough liner compressor) without changing fonts. 4) Single emphasis colour: White/ Black bottom + one emphasis colour (default #FF3B30 Red Orange, following Picture 2 when providing Picture 2); Apart from style segments, there can be no more than a rainbow colour. 5) Symphony sync: text movement, alignment of entry and stay rhythms - each entry falls on the spot and does not float. 6) Clean exercise: Animated cartons smooth, non-diverse, non-scintillated, undecided, slow to move nature (ease-out, stay clean). 7) Layout: text sufficient to be kept, not colliding, unscreened; text may not be permanently shielded from the main face when Picture 1 is provided.

[ANIMATION STYLE — LOCKED: KINETIC SLAM ]:
Cinematic kinetic-typography title sequence. Extreme bold typography (Chinese heavy/ English mixed-bold coded), pure-black background with the ONE accent color (default #FF3B30, or follow <Picture 2>@Picture 2). The user text is broken into phrases/words; EVERY word SLAMS in full-screen — each entrance from a different direction (alternating left / right / top / bottom hammer-in), arriving with impact, a subtle overshoot bounce, and a brief screen-shake beat on landing; the previously landed words shrink slightly and move aside to make room, then snap back bold. The final word of the last phrase tracks apart letter-spacing wide as it lands, then holds. Fast rhythmic pace locked to the beat: one word lands per beat, paragraph changes get a 1-beat silence then the next phrase slams in harder.
[Violent style lock: hammer into high power] dynamic film header. Extreme bold font (Chinese bold/ English hyperbold compression), pure black background + single emphasis colour (default #FF3B30 red orange, provided Picture 2 to follow Picture 2). The user text is divided into phrases/words; each word is "hammer in" - each entry is in a different direction (left/right/top/down double hammer entry), impact is set, a light ejection bullet is set, and a moment is set for tremors (screen vibration); The downed word shrinks the yield and then bounces back to the thick. The last phrase in the last sentence closes with the square and squared. Quick rhythm and beat lock: For every word taken, the paragraph is tossed and the next sentence is hammered harder.

粒子汇聚的沙沙轻响（如细沙流动）；爆炸瞬间的短促爆裂声+高频粒子叮鸣；回流时气流声渐弱；结尾成型时一声悠远余韵。

2) READABILITY: the text stays bold, high-contrast, with clean edges at ALL times; animation may be dramatic but NEVER distorts a character beyond readability.
3) UNIFIED TYPE: one consistent font family throughout the whole video (bold sans-serif / 黑体 for Chinese, bold condensed for English); no font switching mid-shot.
4) SINGLE ACCENT: palette = white/black base + ONE accent color (default #FF3B30 red-orange, or follow <Picture 2>@图2 if provided); never rainbow-multicolor unless the style says so.
5) BEAT-SYNC: text movement, entrance and hold timing lock to the music beat / rhythm; every entrance lands ON a beat, no off-beat drift.
6) CLEAN MOTION: animations are smooth, no stutter, no jitter, no flicker, no clipping; easing is natural (ease-out entrances, crisp holds).
7) LAYOUT: generous margins, no text collision, no screen-edge cropping; when <Picture 1>@图1 is present, text never permanently covers the subject's face.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-8s] Live-action, cinematic quality. Medium-full shot, camera at eye level. Single continuous take, no cuts. The camera slowly pushes in from medium shot to close-medium throughout the 8 seconds, increasing intimacy.

The character from <Picture 1>@图1 stands in front of a full-length mirror inside the EXACT environment from <Picture 3>@图3 — same room, same lighting, same furniture, same wall color. The mirror is large, floor-standing, framed. Face = <Picture 1>@图1 throughout the entire video. The character wears the original outfit from <Picture 1>@图1.

IMPORTANT: The mirror shows a REFLECTION of the character. The character and the reflection are the SAME person — do NOT render two separate characters. The reflection matches the character movements with mirror symmetry.

Step 1 [0-1.5s] — BEFORE: The character stands in front of the mirror, casually adjusting hair or touching the collar. The reflection follows. Outfit = <Picture 1>@图1. The character glances at the reflection, then away — a quiet, ordinary moment. Camera holds at medium shot.

Step 2 [1.5-3s] — THE GLOW: The mirror surface begins to emit a soft warm golden glow from its center, spreading outward like liquid light. Tiny light particles float off the glass. The character notices, turns to face the mirror, eyes widening. The glow intensifies, warming the character face with amber light. Camera pushes in slightly.

Step 3 [3-4s] — THE FLASH: The mirror flares — a burst of warm white light floods the frame for 0.5 seconds, washing out the scene. The character reflexively raises a hand to shield eyes. Sound: a resonant magical chime.

Step 4 [4-5.5s] — THE REVEAL (AFTER): The light fades. The character lowers the hand and looks down. The SAME character, SAME face from <Picture 1>@图1, is now wearing the COMPLETE outfit from <Picture 2>@图2 — every garment, color, pattern, fabric, shoes, hat, bag, jewelry, every accessory copied 1:1 from <Picture 2>@图2. The outfit change is INSTANT behind the flash — no ghosting, no blending, no partial transition. The old outfit is completely gone. The character freezes in shock, mouth slightly open, eyes wide, staring at the new clothes on their body.

Step 5 [5.5-7s] — THE JOY: The character breaks into a surprised laugh, touching the new fabric, running hands over the new garment from <Picture 2>@图2. A delighted spin to one side to feel the new outfit in motion — hem, sleeves, or drape catching air. The mirror reflection shows the same new outfit, same joyful expression. Camera pulls back to medium shot to show the full outfit.

Step 6 [7-8s] — THE ADMIRATION: The character turns back to face the mirror directly, smiling with satisfaction. One hand smooths the collar or adjusts an accessory from <Picture 2>@图2. The mirror glow has faded completely — the mirror is now a normal mirror. Final pose: the character stands confidently, admiring the full reflection. Face = <Picture 1>@图1. Scene = <Picture 3>@图3. Outfit = <Picture 2>@图2.

★ ANTI-GHOSTING: Before the flash = <Picture 1>@图1 outfit. After the flash = <Picture 2>@图2 outfit. Each frame has EXACTLY ONE character. The mirror shows a reflection, NOT a second character. No double exposure, no ghosting, no outfit mixing. The outfit change is a single hard cut hidden behind the flash.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambient from <Picture 3>@图3 at the start. Mirror glow brings a soft crystalline shimmer and rising magical hum. The flash: a warm resonant chime with a bass thump. After the reveal: the character gasp, then a bright surprised laugh, new fabric rustle and jewelry clink from <Picture 2>@图2 outfit, footsteps during the spin. Room ambient returns at the end.

non_diegetic_music: Opens minimal and intimate (soft piano single notes). Builds with mysterious strings as the mirror glows. At the flash: a bright orchestral swell. After the reveal: transitions to an upbeat, cheerful melody with light percussion — playful and confident, matching the character joy. Ends on a warm resolved chord as the character admires the reflection.

templates.description: Direct overhead skylight at Shaw Studios: the face split into light and dark like yin and yang, a metaphor for moral division, the light-and-shadow symbol of Chang Cheh's aesthetic of violence
templates.description_en: Direct overhead skylight at Shaw Studios: the face split into light and dark like yin and yang, a metaphor for moral division, the light-and-shadow symbol of Chang Cheh's aesthetic of violence
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-4s] 1970s Shaw Brothers wuxia film style, saturated color, heavy film grain, studio hall set with painted backdrop of a night forest. A single shaft of hard top light falls from directly above — the classic Shaw studio skylight effect — splitting a kneeling warrior's face into a half-lit, half-shadowed chiaroscuro mask. The lit half shows sweat and grit; the shadowed half hides his eyes in darkness. He grips a long sword planted before him. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] His opponent steps into the same shaft of light from the other side — also split into yin-yang face, the two half-faces facing each other across the light beam. Dust motes drift visibly through the light column. The camera slowly pushes in on their faces as the tension builds, both half-hidden, both half-revealed — moral ambiguity made visible through light. A slow zoom tightens until the frame holds on the two lit halves of their faces, the shadows closing in, then cut to black on the held standoff.

overall_soundscape: Dust motes drifting in silence, cloth shifting, slow breaths, the faint ring of a blade being lifted, a deep drum pulse like a heartbeat under vintage hiss.

non_diegetic_music: Minimal and ominous — low drum pulses and a sustained gong drone, strings playing a single held dissonant chord, intensifying as the camera pushes in, ending on sudden silence.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-4s] 1960s Shaw Brothers wuxia film style, bleach-bypass wasteland tones with intense warm backlight, heavy film grain, studio desert set with painted sand-dune backdrop and blowing sand. A lone rider on horseback is silhouetted against an enormous setting sun — intense backlight with strong highlight clipping, the rider and horse reduced to a clean black cutout with a thin golden rim light tracing their edges. Sand whips across the foreground, catching the light in glowing streaks. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] The rider moves slowly across the frame, a long tracking shot from a low angle. The sun blazes behind him, flaring across the lens. He wears a wide straw hat and a tattered dark cloak; the wind presses the cloth forward, the horse's mane streaming. The silhouette stays perfect — no face, no detail, pure shape and light. He stops on a dune crest, silhouetted against the full blazing disc, and looks back the way he came. Loneliness, dust, and fire-colored sky — the whole frame is light and shadow.

overall_soundscape: Wind across open sand, the horse's slow hoofbeats on sand, saddle leather creaking, cloak snapping in the wind, distant howl of wind over dunes, a faint vintage hiss.

non_diegetic_music: Spare, mournful wuxia theme — a lonely flute melody over a slow drum, strings entering softly, all echoing the vast emptiness, fading with the wind.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] [0-4s] 1970s Shaw Brothers wuxia film style, Technicolor saturation, film grain, studio set of a night chamber with painted backdrop of a moonlit garden. The room is washed in two opposing colored lights — deep red light from stage left, cold blue light from stage right — the classic Shaw red-blue complementary dramatic lighting, soft-edged but boldly contrasting. A beautiful woman in an ornate red-and-gold dress stands where the two lights meet, her face half crimson, half icy blue, tears glistening in both colors. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [4-8s] She turns slowly, the two color fields sliding across her face. In the red light she looks passionate and vengeful; in the blue light, cold and broken. A masked swordsman steps out of the blue shadow behind her — his silhouette rimmed in red. The camera slowly circles, the red and blue pools shifting around them like an expressionist painting. She raises a dagger; the blade catches both colors. The final frame holds them in perfect red-blue balance, frozen in theatrical tension, obviously staged, obviously dramatic — Shaw's unreal, dreamlike artificiality at its peak.

overall_soundscape: Soft fabric rustles, slow footsteps, a dagger being drawn with a whisper of metal, a heartbeat-like low pulse, the faint crackle of vintage audio.

non_diegetic_music: Melodramatic Shaw strings — a sweeping emotional melody alternating between warm and cold registers, with a tense gong roll building to a frozen chord.

A white-robed swordsman and a black-clad assassin fight among the bamboo — but the fight moves like Peking opera: every stance, every leap is a precise theatrical pose, arms and legs held in angular, balletic postures. Bamboo stalks whip through the foreground between them, the camera weaving through the trunks, framing them through natural frames of bamboo and leaves. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000 [5-7s] They break apart; an insert of the bamboo tops swaying against a white sky, mist rolling between the stalks — empty-shot breathing. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000 [7-10s] They clash again in a burst of rapid, percussive motion — blades singing, robes spinning — then freeze in a final theatrical pose, sword-tip to sword-tip, surrounded by drifting mist and gently swaying bamboo. The composition holds them in a large empty space of white mist and green stalks, zen-like, quiet, perfect. The wind moves the bamboo long after they are still.

overall_soundscape: Bamboo creaking and swaying, leaves rustling, the sharp song of blades, opera-like rhythmic footwork, mist drifting, a distant temple bell.

non_diegetic_music: Peking opera percussion with gongs and cymbals in tight patterns during the fight, falling silent for the empty-shot insert, then a lone dizi flute and guqin for the final tableau, deeply serene.

summary:
  Create a 15-second director-style storyboard PV with a full shot sequence (opening hook → development → climax → resolution). Multi-shot editing with clean transitions, directed camera language per shot, and on-screen text as a designed element (title, subtitle, end card) per TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL. Rhythm accelerates toward the climax.
retention_analysis:
  <Subject 1>: fully_preserved across all shots.
<Picture 2>@Picture 2: attribute_transfer — mood, light, color.
<Picture 3>@Picture 3: fully_preserved — shape, color, details, logo.
detailed_description:
  [Shot 1 · Hook] At 00:00.000, an attention-grabbing opening — dramatic angle, high contrast, subject enters frame fast. Title text (if any) slams in per TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL.
  [Shot 2 · Setup] At 00:03.500, medium shot establishing the subject in the scene, camera arcs around at medium speed.
  [Shot 3 · Development] At 00:07.000, action/detail beat — subject in motion or product macro; push-in or tracking move; energy rises.
  [Shot 4 · Climax] At 00:10.500, the strongest visual — hero pose, bold lighting, optional slow-motion feel; brief cutaway accents.
  [Shot 5 · Resolution] At 00:13.000, resolve to a clean hold frame; end-card text (logo/name/slogan) appears per TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL and holds to the end.
overall_soundscape: Layered cuts with whooshes, accent impacts on beat points, ambient bed.
non_diegetic_music: Cinematic PV score — building tension, beat drop at the climax, triumphant resolution.

summary:
Create a 10-second PV whose first frame is EXACTLY <Picture 1>@Picture 1 and whose final frame is EXACTLY <Picture 2>@Picture 2 (when provided). detailed_description:

[Frame B] At 00:10.000, the frame lands EXACTLY on <Picture 2>@Picture 2's composition and holds; end-card text per TEXT OVERLAY CONTROL (optional).

The user text in "" is the locked creative brief. Mandatory rules: 1) Write the style prompt as vivid English sentences, NOT comma-separated tags; it must read like a creative brief for a musician. 2) Sentence pattern: A [mood] [BPM optional] [genre + sub-genre] [song/track]. [Vocal description OR "Instrumental with..." description]. [Narrative/theme — what the song is about]. [Atmosphere/scene details]. [Key instruments and production elements]. 3) Open with a Structured Captions meta header: Genre / BPM / Key / Time signature / Use case / Production character — fill from the brief, use sensible defaults if absent. 4) Track the emotional contour across sections (verse → pre-chorus → chorus → bridge → final chorus); specify instruments' entry and exit, groove and low-end development, and section-level changes in vocal delivery and harmony. 5) Describe vocals as a character (sound color, register, delivery, texture — e.g. "sultry, sophisticated male baritone with smooth jazz inflections and breathy delivery"), never just "female vocal". For instrumentals replace vocals with instrument focus + scene narrative. 6) BPM mapping: 40-60smeditative / 60-80sslow ballad / 80-110smid-tempo groove / 110-130supbeat / 130-160sdriving. 7) Name 2-3skey instruments precisely (piano, Rhodes, synth pad, 808, erhu, guzheng, brushed drums...), leave the rest to the model. 8) Never combine conflicting aesthetics (vintage lo-fi × crisp modern, intimate whisper × powerful belting, minimalist × full orchestra, raw punk × polished pop); rewrite negations ("not too sad") as positive directions. 9) Keep the prompt ≤ 2000 chars; if lyrics exist, keep section tags [Intro]/[Verse]/[Pre-Chorus]/[Chorus]/[Bridge]/[Outro]/[Inst]/[Solo] to define the macrostructure; backing vocals and performance cues go in parentheses (Ooh, yeah) / (Whispered). 10) The English prompt is the primary deliverable; then append a full Chinese working copy for review.

templates.prompt:
A sleek motion graphics intro animation for a self-media channel.
Style: clean modern MG animation, bold kinetic typography.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-1s] Dark navy gradient background, ambient particles floating slowly.
[Shot 2] [1-3s] Geometric shapes slide in from left and right, assembling into a logo placeholder.
[Shot 3] [3-5s] Large channel name text slams into center with spring easing, subtle screen shake.
[Shot 4] [5-7s] Supporting tagline fades in below, thin accent lines draw outward horizontally.
[Shot 5] [7-8s] All elements gently scale back, subtle glow, hold on final frame.

Camera: static locked-off, 2D motion graphics depth.
Lighting: soft top light, subtle rim glow on text, flat ambient fill.
Color palette: deep navy background, electric cyan accents, white typography.

[Shot 4] [8-10s] Brand lockup: channel name centers, glow pulse, hold.

Overall style: clean 2D motion graphics, professional YouTube intro quality.
Typography: bold sans-serif, high contrast, readable at 1080p.
Color scheme: cohesive brand palette, accent color highlights on key words.
Motion rhythm: punchy on emphasis, gentle on supporting text.
No real human footage, pure motion graphics + kinetic typography.
4K sharpness, clean vector edges, broadcast-ready.

overall_soundscape: Subtle UI clicks on text appear, soft whoosh on transitions.

non_diegetic_music: Upbeat electronic background, moderate tempo, clean and professional.
